name: skyteklabs
description: SkyTek Labs plugins for Claude Code: model and effort routing, a live agent dashboard, next-prompt suggestions, a session cost odometer, and a Scope of Work writer

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Router to optimize the model selections based on the type of the job/task working using jev

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Live agent dashboard: main model vitals, on-call architect, permission checks, subagent cards and swimlanes, turn receipt and session log

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Suggests up to three next prompts above the input after each turn; press 1, 2 or 3 to draft one, 0 to dismiss

plugins.name: burner
plugins.description: Live session cost odometer above the prompt: a burning fuse, real-world comparisons, threshold alerts

plugins.name: skytek
plugins.description: Writes a Scope of Work from an RFP or an interview, filled into the company Word template, as .docx and .pdf
